m.s: Rub {lambcutlets} with {garlic*0.5} (crushed), chopped {rosemary}, the finely grated zest of {lemon}, a drizzle of oil and salt. Leave for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 230°C. Boil {potato} whole in salted water for 15 minutes until a knife slides in. Drain and let them steam dry for a couple of minutes.
Smash the potatoes flat on an oiled tray with the bottom of a glass. Drizzle the tops with oil, season and roast for 25 to 30 minutes until crisp and golden.
Finely chop {parsley}, {mint} and {capers}. Mix with the lemon juice, the rest of the garlic (crushed), a pinch of salt and enough oil to make it spoonable.
Heat a heavy frying pan or BBQ over high heat. Stand the cutlets fat side down for the first minute to render the fat, then cook for 2 to 3 minutes a side for pink in the middle. Rest for 5 minutes.
Chop {cos} and {cucumber} and dress with a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of oil. Serve the cutlets with the salsa verde spooned over, the potatoes and the salad.

l: Pack the cutlets with potatoes and salad, salsa verde on the side. Eat at room temp, not reheated. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
